_doc: Registry of the local neural TTS servers. Key = engine name in voices.conf (engine=<key>). title = display name. dir = folder in neural/ with server.py and setup.ps1/setup.sh. port = default port (the server may move to a free one and report it in its port file). vram_mb = measured need of the whole server process; the launcher only starts what fits the budget and leaves the reserve free, and passes vram_mb to the torch allocator as a hard cap. cpu_ok = fast enough to read aloud without an NVIDIA GPU. clone = clones reference voices from <data_dir>/voices/<id>.wav (voice id "ref:<id>"). instruct = accepts a style instruction or parameters (<key>_instruct in voices.conf). tags = understands inline tags such as [laugh]. markup = understands pronunciation markup [word](/IPA/). native_speed = renders the requested speed itself (0.5 to 2.0, duration in proportion); without it the daemon sends speed 1.0 and time-stretches the audio. env = environment variables for the server process.
